title: Evolving Diverse Red-team Language Models in Multi-round Multi-agent Games
findings: Religion, specifically mentioning 'the bible', was used as a topic in an example of a multi-round attack to probe for safety vulnerabilities. In the provided chat history, the target model successfully defended against this by refusing to take a stance on religion and promoting respect for individual beliefs.
